payload.prompt: Nous avons reçu la facture INV-2026-4914 du fournisseur Océan SARL (nº org. 853705209) de 56300 NOK TTC. Le montant concerne des services de bureau (compte 6500). Enregistrez la facture fournisseur avec la TVA déductible correcte (25 %).

payload.goal: Enregistrer la facture fournisseur INV-2026-4914 d'Océan SARL pour 56 300 NOK TTC (TVA 25 % déductible) sur le compte 6500 (services de bureau).
success_checks: Le fournisseur Océan SARL (nº org. 853705209) existe dans Tripletex
La facture fournisseur INV-2026-4914 est enregistrée avec le montant TTC de 56 300 NOK
La TVA déductible de 25 % est correctement calculée : montant HT = 45 040 NOK, TVA = 11 260 NOK
L'imputation comptable est affectée au compte 6500 (services de bureau)
Le statut de la facture est 'enregistrée' / 'approuvée' dans le système
risk_notes: Le montant de 56 300 NOK est TTC : HT = 56 300 / 1,25 = 45 040 NOK, TVA = 11 260 NOK — à vérifier avant saisie
Le numéro d'organisation 853705209 doit être validé (format norvégien = 9 chiffres, OK ici)
Si le fournisseur Océan SARL n'existe pas encore dans Tripletex, il faut le créer avant d'enregistrer la facture
La date de la facture et la date d'échéance ne sont pas précisées — risque de rejet si champs obligatoires manquants
Le compte 6500 doit exister dans le plan comptable Tripletex ; à vérifier ou créer si absent
Le code TVA déductible correct (TVA sur achats 25 %) doit être sélectionné dans Tripletex (généralement code 1 ou équivalent)
payload.suggested_first_action: Vérifier l'existence du fournisseur Océan SARL via GET /supplier?organizationNumber=853705209 ; si absent, le créer via POST /supplier.
ordered_steps: 1. GET /supplier?organizationNumber=853705209 — vérifier si Océan SARL existe déjà
2. Si absent : POST /supplier — créer Océan SARL avec organizationNumber=853705209
3. Vérifier l'existence du compte 6500 via GET /ledger/account?number=6500
4. POST /supplierInvoice — créer la facture fournisseur avec : invoiceNumber=INV-2026-4914, supplierId=[id Océan SARL], amountIncludingVat=56300, currency=NOK
5. Ajouter la ligne de facture : montant HT=45040 NOK, TVA 25%=11260 NOK, compte=6500
6. Appliquer le code TVA déductible 25 % (input VAT) sur la ligne
7. Valider et enregistrer la facture via PUT /supplierInvoice/{id}/:approve ou action d'approbation équivalente
8. Vérifier le voucher généré via GET /voucher?supplierInvoiceId={id} pour confirmer les imputations comptables

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.

When using vatType != 0 (e.g. VAT 25%), include ONLY the debit posting with the GROSS amount (incl VAT). Tripletex auto-generates VAT split and credit posting. If this fails with a balance error, fall back to manual postings for all legs.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Always resolve account numbers via GET /ledger/account?number=XXXX first, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
Postings with vatType={"id":0} (exempt) can include both debit and credit lines manually.
FORBIDDEN: /supplierInvoice is not available in sandbox.
Use POST /ledger/voucher with supplier reference instead. See register_supplier_invoice playbook.

payload.trace_example_task: Create supplier then register invoice via /incomingInvoice or /ledger/voucher. 3-5 API calls.

payload.text:
Let me analyze the task:

1. Register supplier invoice INV-2026-4914 from Océan SARL (org# 853705209)
2. Amount: 56,300 NOK TTC (including VAT)
3. Account: 6500 (office services)
4. VAT: 25% deductible

From the sandbox_discovery, the supplier already exists with id 108446748.

Steps needed:
1. Supplier already exists (id: 108446748) - skip creation
2. GET /ledger/account?number=6500 to resolve account ID
3. POST /ledger/voucher with one debit posting (gross amount 56300, vatType id 3 for 25%)


4. Now I'll execute the API calls to fetch the account details and create the voucher with the appropriate VAT posting.

Looking at the task: register supplier invoice INV-2026-4914 from Océan SARL for 56,300 NOK TTC with 25% VAT on account 6500.

From sandbox_discovery, supplier Océan SARL already exists with **id: 108446748**. I need to resolve account 6500 then create the voucher.

Account 6500 resolved to ID **475990461**. I notice the legal VAT types don't include id=3. Let me check what VAT type corresponds to 25% input VAT. The account's default vatType is id=1. Looking at the legal vatTypes, I see id=1 is listed. For input VAT 25%, I need to check if vatType id=3 is valid here. The legal types include: 0, 1, 11, 12, 230, 13, 14, 34, 35, 559, 550, 551, 553, 560. VAT type 3 is NOT in the legal list but type 1 is there.

Let me consult the advisor to clarify the correct input VAT type for 25% on expense accounts.

payload.question: I'm creating a voucher posting for a supplier invoice on account 6500 (expense account). The legal VAT types for this account are: 0, 1, 11, 12, 230, 13, 14, 34, 35, 559, 550, 551, 553, 560. VAT type id=3 (output 25%) is NOT in the legal list. Which VAT type ID should I use for 25% INPUT VAT (deductible VAT on purchases/incoming invoices) from this list? The playbook says vatType id 3 = 25% but that seems to be output VAT.

payload.response_preview:
## Answer: Use VAT Type ID **1** (25% Input VAT / Inngående MVA)

### The Correct VAT Type

From your legal list for account 6500, **`id=1`** is the standard **25% input VAT (deductible purchase VAT)*

payload.headline: All 4 checks failed: used /ledger/voucher instead of /supplierInvoice endpoint
what_went_wrong: Used POST /ledger/voucher (manual journal) instead of POST /supplierInvoice — the task explicitly requires registering a supplier invoice, which has its own dedicated endpoint with different field structure.
All 4 scoring checks failed (score 0.0/8.0), suggesting the scorer looks for a supplierInvoice entity, not a voucher, meaning the entire approach was wrong from the start.
First POST /ledger/voucher attempt failed with 422 (sum != 0) because only one posting was provided — wasted an API call before switching to 3-posting approach.
Fetched accounts 2711 and 2710 separately (2 calls) when only 2710 was needed — the 2711 lookup was unnecessary after recognizing it was the wrong VAT account.
what_worked: Correctly identified supplier Océan SARL (id 108446748) from sandbox_discovery without an extra lookup call.
Math was correct: 56300 / 1.25 = 45040 net, 11260 VAT, postings summed to zero.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice (not /ledger/voucher) with fields like invoiceNumber, supplierId, amountIncludingVat, currency, and orderLines referencing account 6500 with vatType for 25% input VAT.
Check the /supplierInvoice endpoint schema carefully — it likely handles VAT splitting automatically when amountIncludingVat and vatType are provided, avoiding manual 3-posting construction.
Eliminate the redundant GET /ledger/account for account 2711 (wrong VAT account) — resolve the correct VAT account (2710) directly or let the supplierInvoice endpoint handle it automatically.
unnecessary_calls: GET /ledger/account for account 2711 — fetched wrong VAT account, immediately discarded after checking description
First POST /ledger/voucher with single posting — predictably failed (sum != 0), should have used 3 postings or correct endpoint from start
GET /ledger/account for account 2710 — would be unnecessary if using /supplierInvoice which handles VAT accounts automatically
